name: ancestor-research
description: Ask questions of your Ancestor Research family tree: profiles, relationships, research evidence with per-gate scoring, audit findings, leads, and research triggers. Read-and-trigger only — the Evidence Firewall means nothing writes to the tree; research results are reviewed in the app.

project_database.title: Project database
project_database.description: Your Ancestor Research project .sqlite file. Find it via the app: Settings → Projects (usually under ~/Library/Containers/dev.dreamfold.Ancestor-Research/…/AncestorResearch/projects/).
